issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff changes only N_TREES from 300 to 1000. It adds no file or network access, no hard-coded answers and no use of test labels.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. More trees in a random forest only reduces variance between fits. Job time goes up about 3x, which should stay well under the 10-minute limit.

Recomputed z from the rounded numbers: (0.3979 - 0.3968) / (0.0037 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = 0.0011 / 0.00523 ≈ 0.21. The harness gives 0.193. The gap fits the 4-decimal rounding: an unrounded difference of about 0.00101 would give 0.193. Both values are far below significance, so rejecting is correct.
Each side has only one run, so the comparison has little power. The improvement of about 0.001 is about 0.3 noise sd. If anyone wants to adopt this change, a replicate run is needed first.
